name: Add Single Row
description: Add a single row of data to Google Sheets. Optionally insert the row at a specific index (e.g., row 2 to insert after headers, shifting existing data down). [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values/append)

configurable_props.name: drive
configurable_props.label: Drive
configurable_props.description: Defaults to `My Drive`. To select a [Shared Drive](https://support.google.com/a/users/answer/9310351) instead, select it from this list.

configurable_props.name: sheetId
configurable_props.label: Spreadsheet ID
configurable_props.description: Select a spreadsheet or provide a spreadsheet ID

configurable_props.name: worksheetId
configurable_props.label: Worksheet ID
configurable_props.description: Select a worksheet or enter a custom expression. When referencing a spreadsheet dynamically, you must provide a custom expression for the worksheet.

configurable_props.name: hasHeaders
configurable_props.label: Does the first row of the sheet have headers?
configurable_props.description: If the first row of your document has headers, we'll retrieve them to make it easy to enter the value for each column. Note: When using a dynamic reference for the worksheet ID (e.g. `{{steps.foo.$return_value}}`), this setting is ignored.

configurable_props.name: rowIndex
configurable_props.label: Row Index
configurable_props.description: The row number where the new row should be inserted (e.g., `2` to insert after the header row, shifting existing data down). If not specified, the row will be appended to the end of the sheet. **Note:** Row numbers start at 1. If your sheet has headers, use `2` or higher to avoid overwriting them.
